highlights: Aurobindo Pharma delivered another strong quarter, supported by broad-based momentum across its core formulations businesses, continued growth in key geographies and steady progress in differentiated segments.

Additionally, advancements in biosimilars, biologics contract manufacturing and Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisation (CDMO) initiatives provide multiple medium-term growth avenues beyond the traditional generics portfolio.
Management remains focused on sustaining profitability through an improved product mix, operating leverage and better utilisation of recently established capacities.
